Our work

35 photographs of finished roofs, leadwork and jobs in progress from around Cannock and Staffordshire.

In short

Every photograph below is our own work. Most of a roof is somewhere you will never stand, which is exactly why we photograph each stage as we go: the membrane, the battens and the leadwork are the parts that decide whether a roof lasts, and they are all hidden by the time the job looks finished.
